commands.label: usb-disk-info
commands.note: Check USB partition style (MBR vs GPT). Write result to C:\Signal\usb_disk_info.txt then relay back.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'C:\Signal' | Out-Null; Get-Disk | Where-Object {$_.Size -gt 100GB -and $_.Size -lt 200GB} | Select-Object Number,PartitionStyle,Size | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File 'C:\Signal\usb_disk_info.txt' -Encoding ascii; $content = Get-Content 'C:\Signal\usb_disk_info.txt' -Raw; $payload = @{cmd='cmd-017-result'; data=$content} | ConvertTo-Json; $payload | Out-File 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\from_cli.json' -Encoding ascii"

commands.label: claude-boot-usb-copy
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'D:\claude_boot' | Out-Null; $base = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EndoScorpion/Signal/relay/claude_boot'; @('kali_claude.sh','ubuntu_claude.sh','BOOT_KEY.txt','README.txt') | ForEach-Object { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/$_" -OutFile "D:\claude_boot\$_" -UseBasicParsing }; Write-Output 'DONE'"

commands.label: watchdog-reg
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$vbs = '$wsh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $wsh.Run(\"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\\Users\\endos\\Signal\\relay\\claude_watchdog.ps1\", 0, $false)'; Set-Content -Path $env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs -Value $vbs; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs"; $trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn; $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit 0; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'ClaudeWatchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1 -Settings $settings -RunLevel Highest -Force"
